title: Score Comparability for Translated and Adapted Exams
text: 60 items; reference n = 2,000; translated group 0.5 logits lower; ~35% items carry adaptation features make mostly harder translation. DIF detection (items DIF > 0.2 logits, target FDR 10%): EB power every size, FDR control anti-conservative n ≤ 100 (13–19% realized vs 10% target). sizes, treat flags candidates expert translation review, conclusions. DIF effect estimation (RMSE, logits): EB shrinkage vs raw differences: 0.28 vs 0.38 (n = 50), 0.22 vs 0.26 (n = 100), 0.16 vs 0.20 (n = 200). DIF-free items error cut half; genuinely large DIF shrunk somewhat toward slab mean. Linking (true shift 0.5): Mean linking biased directional DIF, data fix . mixture nearly unbiased n = 50–100, RMSE better iterative purification. 17–33% fits weakly identified. current recommendation report , report whenever warning fires. Improving linking estimator top open item. Impact: 90% intervals pass-rate change cover truth 83% replications n = 150 (mean width 5.5 points). covered 50% linking uncertainty propagated. Features: idiom, cultural referent, units vocabulary effects recovered (true 0.60 / 0.50 / -0.40 / 0.35; mean estimates 0.62 / 0.52 / -0.42 / 0.29), 95% CI coverage 83–100%.
